task_title: Checkout total with student discount and tax
spec: Add a checkout total function `checkout_total(items, student=False)` in checkout.py. Each item is a dict with keys name (str), price (float), qty (int), kind ('food'|'book'|'gift_card'). Students get 10% off, but never on gift cards. Food is tax-free; everything else has 8% sales tax applied after discounts. Round to cents. Reject negative quantities with ValueError.
